description: This file defines the CustomField class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It contains methods to handle adding, editing, and deleting custom fields, primarily by scheduling tasks related to customer groups. The class interacts with models for tasks and custom fields, and the methods are triggered after specific model operations.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class handling custom field events, scheduling tasks after add, edit, or delete operations.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Schedules a task to update customer group info after a custom field is added.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Schedules a task to update customer group info after a custom field is edited.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Schedules a task to update customer group info after a custom field is deleted.
